Join Vietlook Travel on a one-day Hanoi City Tour to explore iconic landmarks, ancient pagodas, and historic sites. Immerse yourself in the city’s rich culture and vibrant history, offering the perfect introduction to Hanoi’s essence in just one day

THE PRICE PER PERSON IN USD

Transport Seats Price (USD/PAX) Additional Charge for Option
Shuttle Bus (County 29 seats) 29 seats 28 USD/PAX +12 USD/PAX
Limousine (Fuso 17 seats) 17 seats 38 USD/PAX +12 USD/PAX

TOUR INCLUDES

  • Limousine Bus/Shuttle bus during the trip

  • English speaking guide (with at least 5 years of experience)

  • A bottle of water

  • Entrance tickets

  • Vietnamese lunch (menu available upon request)

TOUR EXCLUDES

  • Drinks for lunch

  • Tips for the tour guide & driver

  • Personal expenses or any other items not mentioned above

CHILDREN POLICY

  • From 1-4 years old: Free of charge, sharing the service with parents (Surcharge: 5 USD/seat for shuttle bus, 10 USD/seat for limousine bus)

  • From 5-8 years old: 75% of the adult price (Applies for 1 child, the second child will be charged 100% of the adult price)

  • From 9 years old and above: 100% of the adult price

SPECIAL NOTES

  • Please bring necessary items such as cash, cellphone or camera, raincoat/umbrella, sunblock (depending on the weather).

  • The Cyclo Ride/Puppet Show option will be done at the end of the tour.

  • The tour may finish earlier or later depending on the situation.

  • The order of the itinerary may change based on the guide’s arrangement.
